title: Sales Associate
summary: Help customers find the right products and keep our showroom running smoothly.
responsibilities: Greet and advise customers in the showroom
Process orders and follow up on quotations
Keep product displays and stock tidy
requirements: Retail or sales experience is a plus

title: Warehouse Staff
summary: Receive, store and dispatch goods accurately and safely.
responsibilities: Check incoming deliveries against purchase orders
Take part in regular stock counts
requirements: Able to lift and move goods

title: Finance Administrator
summary: Keep invoices, payments and records accurate and up to date.
requirements: Diploma or degree in accounting or finance
